title: mos.drive.v1
description: Static drive facts emitted by `mos drive --json`: what IS this drive, vs mos.metadata.v1's what disc is this (design: doc/research/2026-06-10-media-info-design.md, schema taxonomy). Identity is open-time directory data (zero commands); capabilities are one GET CONFIGURATION RT=0 feature walk. The drive-disc JOIN is consumer-side: the pipeline that loaded a disc knows which drive it used. serial — when it arrives — is the durable inventory key that survives replug and machine moves; registry_id is ATTACHMENT identity (replug mints a new one) and must not be used as a durable key.

bsd.description: Whole-disk dev node of the current media, or null when the drive is empty. Addressing context — a drive property only while this disc is loaded.

registry_id.description: Drive service IORegistry entry ID — attachment identity, the state/event join key. 0 = unavailable. NOT durable: replug mints a new ID by construction.

vendor.description: INQUIRY-derived vendor string (DiscRecording pre-parsed directory data), null when the directory has no identity. Same sanitization rules as mos.state.v1.

product.description: Product identity, same terms as vendor.

revision.description: Firmware revision (SPC-4 PRODUCT_REVISION_LEVEL), same terms as vendor.

serial.description: INQUIRY unit serial (VPD page 0x80) — the durable drive-inventory key. STAGE 1: always null; whether the convenience InquiryDevice surfaces VPD pages is a recorded Mac falsifier (design doc, 2026-06-12 addendum), and a raw INQUIRY would need the AGENTS raw-verb showing. The key is present so the v1 field set never moves when the value arrives.

capabilities.description: Spec-grounded GET CONFIGURATION facts only — the same bits a MakeMKV drive dump shows as 'Highest AACS version' / bus-encryption flags, WITHOUT the LibreDrive status synthesis (a MakeMKV database property, not a drive property; mos emits no libredrive field by design).

aacs.description: AACS feature (0x010D) present in the feature list. false on every non-BD drive — data, not an error.

aacs_version.description: AACS Version (feature payload byte 3), null when aacs is false.

bus_encryption.description: DRIVE-REPORTED bus-encryption support (feature payload byte 0 bit 1, per libaacs/UDFclient agreement), null when aacs is false. A firmware assertion: the cryptographically signed BEC bit lives in the AACS drive certificate behind REPORT KEY, which mos does not issue (scope doctrine).

allOf.title: aacs false forces null version and bus_encryption
allOf.description: Both fields decode from the AACS feature payload; without the feature there is nothing to report and false/0 would fabricate a reading.
